day_line: Rain and mist on a Rabbit day. Soft and quiet: good for gentle talks and tidying loose ends, easy to drift.

lines.Yang Wood: Someone has your back today. Let a colleague take the slides; buy them kopi.
lines.Yin Wood: A quiet idea lands mid-week. Put it in your notes app before lunch steals it.
lines.Yang Fire: Your effort gets seen today. Show the work, not just the result, then log off on time.
lines.Yin Fire: Wednesday leans on you a bit. Pick the one task that matters; let the rest wait.
lines.Yang Earth: Small savings add up today. Pack lunch and skip the second bubble tea.
lines.Yin Earth: A useful chance shows up today. Reply to that message first; the inbox can wait.
lines.Yang Metal: Your words carry today. Say the idea in the meeting; keep it to two sentences.
lines.Yin Metal: Your good taste shines today. Tidy the desk, add one plant, enjoy the view.
lines.Yang Water: Someone wants the same thing today. Share the credit; you'll both look better.
lines.Yin Water: Your people are near today. Text the friend you owe a reply; plan a cheap dinner.
